article_content: Four sisters channeled their grief into a symbolic tribute, completing Wisconsin's Udder Mudder race in bridesmaid gowns to honor Shannon Hall. The 24-year-old bride-to-be died on September 2 when her fiancé's car collided with a school bus carrying 22 Pulaski High volleyball players and staff near Highway 29. During the 3.1-mile Marshfield course, the siblings wore purple dresses intended for Hall's October 4 wedding. 'This was our way of celebrating her vibrant spirit,' said emotional sister Angie Guralski. Injured fiancé Justin Cyzan observed the memorial race from a support vehicle while recovery continues. The collision injured 13 students, with six hospitalized and later discharged. Brown County Sheriff's investigators are assisting Shawano County's ongoing crash analysis. Pastor Vorpagel revealed the couple had exchanged heartfelt vows during final counseling, adding poignancy to their loss.

article_content: (CNN) — Aspiring Mars visitors face a sobering reality: Radiation measurements from Curiosity rover's journey reveal exposure levels surpassing NASA's safety thresholds. Scientists confirmed Thursday that a Martian round trip would subject astronauts to radiation equivalent to biweekly abdominal CT scans. 'The cruise phase alone delivers radiation doses approaching career limits,' said Cary Zeitlin, lead scientist for NASA's Martian Radiation Environment Experiment. Data from Curiosity's Radiation Assessment Detector, published in Science, indicates 554-770 millisieverts of ionizing radiation exposure during transit—over 100 times Earth's annual average. NASA's safety protocol caps exposure at a 3% increased lifetime cancer risk. While current propulsion systems enable 180-day one-way trips (versus Curiosity's 253-day 2012 voyage), radiation expert Eddie Semones notes effective shielding against galactic cosmic rays would require 'several-meter-thick materials.' NASA's Chris Moore outlined dual strategies: developing faster engines for 2030s missions and designing spacecraft with water-based shielding. 'Water's hydrogen content offers superior protection,' he explained. The study found solar particle events contributed only 5% of measured radiation, though intensity varies. Ongoing research explores electromagnetic shielding and storm shelters for solar events. Apollo missions' shorter duration minimized similar daily radiation risks. Current guidelines permit 35-year-old male non-smokers 180-239 safe space days. Private ventures like Mars One (78,000 applicants for 2023 settlement) and Inspiration Mars' proposed 501-day 2018 flyby underscore public enthusiasm, though radiation mitigation remains unresolved.
translated_content: (सिएनएन) — मंगल यात्राको सपना देख्नेहरूको लागि एउटा गम्भीर चुनौती: क्युरियोसिटी रोभरबाट प्राप्त तथ्यांकले विकिरणको खतरनाक स्तर देखाएको छ। गुरुवार प्रकाशित अध्ययन अनुसार मंगल यात्राको समयमा अन्तरिक्ष यात्रीहरूले नासाको स्वीकृत सुरक्षा सीमाभन्दा धेरै विकिरण सहनुपर्नेछ। नासा वैज्ञानिक केरी जेटलिनले स्पष्ट गरे, 'यात्राको समयमा प्राप्त विकिरणको मात्रा प्रत्येक पाँच दिनमा एउटा पेटको सिटी स्क्यान गर्ने बराबर हुनेछ।' विज्ञान पत्रिकामा प्रकाशित तथ्यांकले ५५४ देखि ७७० मिलिसिभर्ट सम्मको आयोनिङ विकिरण जोखिम देखाएको छ — यो अमेरिकी नागरिकले प्राकृतिक र चिकित्सा स्रोतबाट वार्षिक प्राप्त गर्ने ६.२ मिलिसिभर्टभन्दा सयौं गुणा बढी हो। नासाको विकिरण विशेषज्ञ एडी सेमोन्सले स्पष्ट गरे, 'ग्यालाक्टिक कस्मिक किरणबाट पूर्ण सुरक्षाको लागि धेरै मिटर मोटो शिल्ड चाहिन्छ, जुन अन्तरिक्षयानमा प्रयोग गर्न असम्भव छ।' नासाको क्रिस मूरले २०३० दशकसम्म यात्रा समय घटाउने इन्जिन विकास र पानी आधारित सुरक्षा प्रणालीको डिजाइन बारे बताए। उनले भने, 'पानीमा भएको हाइड्रोजनले उत्तम सुरक्षा दिन्छ।' अध्ययनले सौर्य कणहरूले मात्र ५% जोखिम बढाएको देखाए पनि यसको तीव्रता अनियमित हुन सक्छ। नासा सौर्य तूफानबाट बच्न विशेष आश्रय र चुम्बकीय क्षेत्र प्रविधि विकास गरिरहेको छ। एपोलो अभियानको छोटो अवधिले विकिरण जोखिम न्यून बनाएको थियो। हालको नियम अनुसार ३५ वर्षीय गैर-धूम्रपानी पुरुषले १८०-२३९ दिन अन्तरिक्षमा बस्न सक्छन्। मार्स वनको २०२३ मा चार जनाको मंगल बसाइँसराइ र इन्स्पिरेसन मार्सको २०१८ को ५०१ दिने उडान योजनाले जनआकांक्षा देखाए पनि विकिरण सम्बन्धी समाधान अझै चुनौतीपूर्ण नै छ।

article_content: Washington (CNN) – House Minority Leader Nancy Pelosi strongly rebutted Senator Chuck Schumer's critique of Democratic strategy following the 2008 financial crisis. The intra-party disagreement centers on whether prioritizing healthcare reform over continued economic initiatives was politically advantageous. At a National Press Club event, Schumer argued: 'After the stimulus package, Democrats should've sustained focus on middle-class programs rather than shifting to healthcare. We misread our mandate.' Pelosi countered via statement: 'We govern to solve problems, not preserve power. The 14 million Americans gaining health coverage prove our approach's merit.' Pelosi's office clarified the 14 million figure includes 8 million ACA exchange enrollments, 6 million Medicaid expansion beneficiaries, and young adults staying on parental plans until 26. They emphasized the ACA's role in slowing healthcare cost growth and noted the House passed a $154 billion jobs bill in 2009 that stalled in the Senate. The debate resurfaces as House Republicans challenge ACA implementation through litigation. While Schumer voted for the ACA, he maintains different legislative sequencing could've better served Democratic prospects. A White House official and former Obama administration figures declined to endorse either position publicly.
